title: Observation, reversible records and the Fold erasure ledger
description:
Macroscopic irreversibility and microscopic reconstruction from one exact retained record. Maria Smith derives observation-fibre entropy orientation, complete boundary-energy accounting and the closed sorting–memory–environment ledger in Smithian Fold Theory.

The Fold reset fibre is exactly quarter-One and three-quarter-One, both mapping to half-One. One binary distinction closes; a retained predecessor label restores the source. Every finite list of original sorting cycles has equal gained, erased and exported counts. Includes full mathematical arguments, arbitrary-support and finite-ledger Lean proofs, all original Landauer theory/experiment conditions, V3/V4 citations and reproducible source evidence.

Eight source entries, 2,816 complete candidate decisions and 1,034 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations. Topics: information erasure, Maxwell demon, Landauer principle, reversible computation, entropy, thermodynamics, observation fibres and native Lean verification.

Read the complete paper PDF. Full native source, exact-arithmetic reproduction and original comparison evidence are included.
